articles.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
articles.snippet: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

articles.title: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
articles.snippet: As geopolitical and technological threats multiply, the big question is whether you can hold on to your wealth and access funds when the system fails.

articles.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

articles.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
articles.snippet: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

articles.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.
